name: rlane.job
description: Routine-lane gate for Mike's job-push routines (AINA scorer, applier, recruiter sends, Gmail/Airtable sync, LinkedIn discovery, prep drafts). Judges one run output.

artifact.instructions: The run output names at least one concrete produced artifact a reader can check: a file path, a row count read back from a store, a URL, a decision id, or a command with its exit code.

blocked_line.instructions: Decides only whether the RUN itself is blocked. Answer 0 when the only park lines are per-item park values with a reason -- PARKED:DRAFT_ONLY, PARKED:HOLD, PARKED:RECRUITER, PARKED:<REASON> in general: those are terminal item states and are NOT blocked. Answer 1 only when the output has a run-level BLOCKED, FAILED or ERROR line, or a bare PARKED without a reason saying the run could not do its scheduled work. Saying there was nothing to do is NOT blocked.

per_item_state.instructions: Every job or item the run touched is listed with an id and a terminal state such as scored, submitted, skipped with a reason, or parked with a reason. Parked with a reason includes PARKED:DRAFT_ONLY, PARKED:HOLD and PARKED:RECRUITER: those are terminal states and the run must keep them, not drop them. A batch where every item has an id and one of those terminal values is complete and fully terminal: answer 1. Answer 0 only when items are missing ids or are left in limbo with no terminal state.

approval_cited.instructions: If the run submitted, sent, or messaged anything outward, it cites the approval id or approval file that authorized it. If nothing outward happened, answer yes.

comp_or_secret.instructions: The output prints a salary figure, a compensation number, an API key, a token, or a password.

quality.instructions: How strong this run output is as evidence the lane's done-test was met.
criteria: Claim with no artifact or content
Names the mode or command but not the result
Artifact plus real content, no BLOCKED line
Artifact, real content, counts it can back up, and the next step or next run named

rules.reason: run reported BLOCKED/FAILED/ERROR: done-test not met
items lack ids or terminal states
outward action without a cited approval
comp figure or secret in run output
output is not evidence of a met done-test

notes.done_test: Each job worked has an id and a terminal state (scored/submitted/parked with reason); counts are read back from the store; no outward action outside a named approval id.

notes.policy: ESCALATE-only and never_auto until calibrated with labelled runs; no BLOCK rules by design.
notes.scope: one rubric per routine lane, judges a routine RUN OUTPUT, not its definition
